pages.text: Plasma Filler: $(4)Fusion Rod + 1,000 mb of matching plasma → 1 plasma fuel rod$(0), taking 100 ticks.$(br2)This is the last stop for fusion fuel: once the rod is in hand, stuff it straight into the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l).

$(bold)Match the rod:$(0) each Fusion Rod demands the $(bold)matching plasma$(0) — mixed components make Mixed rods, Nether components make Nether rods, End components make End rods.$(br2)Rod stats: $(l:akaishi:plasma_rods)Plasma Fuel Rods$(/l); how the Fusion Reactor is laid out: $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l).
Plasma arrives from the $(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l); chain overview in $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l).
